divisions.title: Othniel & Ehud
divisions.theme: Israel enters the cycle of rebellion
divisions.summary: The pattern begins: sin, oppression, crying out, deliverance

divisions.title: Deborah & Barak
divisions.summary: A prophetess leads Israel; Jael drives the tent peg

divisions.title: Gideon
divisions.summary: Three hundred men with torches and trumpets rout Midian

divisions.title: Abimelech
divisions.summary: Abimelech murders his brothers and establishes himself as king

divisions.title: Jephthah
divisions.theme: A warrior makes a tragic vow
divisions.summary: Jephthah defeats Ammon but his vow costs him everything

divisions.title: Israel's Collapse

chapterSummaries.1: Israel fails to drive out the Canaanites completely
chapterSummaries.2: The angel of the LORD rebukes Israel; the cycle of judges begins
chapterSummaries.3: Othniel, Ehud, and Shamgar deliver Israel
chapterSummaries.4: Deborah and Barak defeat Sisera; Jael kills him with a tent peg
chapterSummaries.5: The Song of Deborah celebrates the victory
chapterSummaries.6: Gideon called while hiding from Midian; destroys the altar of Baal
chapterSummaries.7: God reduces Gideon's army to 300; Midian routed
chapterSummaries.8: Gideon pursues the Midianite kings; makes an ephod that becomes a snare
chapterSummaries.9: Abimelech kills his brothers and becomes king; killed by a millstone
chapterSummaries.10: Israel oppressed by Ammon; they cry out to the LORD
chapterSummaries.11: Jephthah defeats Ammon; his tragic vow
chapterSummaries.12: Jephthah and the Ephraimites; minor judges
chapterSummaries.13: Samson's birth announced to Manoah and his wife
chapterSummaries.14: Samson's riddle at his wedding feast
chapterSummaries.15: Samson defeats the Philistines with a donkey's jawbone
chapterSummaries.16: Delilah betrays Samson; his death brings down the Philistine temple
chapterSummaries.17: Micah sets up his own shrine and priest
chapterSummaries.18: The Danites steal Micah's idols and priest
chapterSummaries.19: The Levite's concubine and the atrocity at Gibeah
chapterSummaries.21: Wives found for the surviving Benjamites
